evidence: Carries the Mining label and modifies WaitTipChanged and WaitAndCreateNewBlock in src/interfaces/mining.h and src/node/block_template_manager.cpp.
rationale: Hardens mining interface methods against negative and NaN timeouts from external callers. The author notes that on debug builds 'a negative or NaN timeout fails this check and aborts the node' while in release builds NaN values cause unintended wait delays, though no known client currently sends these values.
